@graph.description:
Quality-diversity search over map-constrained start/goal paths, static obstacle count and
lateral placement, dynamic obstacle trigger/lateral placement, controller profile, fixed Navfn
global planner, and GridBased.use_astar. MPPI and DWB are the two controller profiles. The QD objective is raw
/behavior_tree_log node coverage of navigate_to_pose_w_replanning_and_recovery.xml.

The room is the ROS 2 `turtlebot3_world` (roqsim_scenes:tb3_world): a hexagonal room 5.080 m
flat-to-flat inside its wall, with nine columns of r = 0.15 m on a 3x3 grid at 1.1 m spacing. Its
occupancy grid is projected from that scene, so the map and the world hold the same obstacles. The
world resolves from the installed scene package rather than from run_files, so the campaign image
must carry a roqsim that has it.
@graph.title: QD Nav2 behavior-tree coverage search -- navigate to pose -- tb3_world
